title: 節點計量器重啟、計數器重置、Outbox 佇列上限與安全停轉發 (Node Sampler Restart, Counter Reset, Outbox Caps & Safety Fail-Closed)
expected: Node sampler persists checkpoints and monotonic event_seq across agent restart without double-counting, emits a counter_discontinuity gap without negative deltas when kernel counters reset, and withdraws member forwarding (keeping the control channel up) when the lease/heartbeat expires or outbox/disk safety caps are breached.
actual: Live node fvpn-w4-usage-node verified sampler restart continuity (event_seq 1->2), D-067 provisional-lease recovery across bring_up (5860ms/6786ms) and agent_restart (5944ms/6248ms), and live fail-closed withdrawal via fvpn-watchdog.

mechanism_checks.name: LiveSamplerRestartAndWatchdogFailClosed
mechanism_checks.summary: Live node fvpn-w4-usage-node preserved monotonic event_seq (1->2) and clean outbox upload across restart, and withdrew forwarding to generation 0 via fvpn-watchdog while keeping mTLS control-plane HTTP 200.

mechanism_checks.name: LiveD067ProvisionalLeaseTimingBringUpAndAgentRestart
mechanism_checks.summary: D-067 provisional lease (members:[], 60s central backstop) reported awaiting_member_grants (AWAITING_MEMBER_GRANTS on lease/qos/source_binding, 1 errors[] entry at stage=lease, zero LEASE_EXPIRED) and recovered to a populated lease (members=2, ttl=86400s) in 5860ms (bring_up) and 5944ms (agent_restart), both <= 65000ms.

mechanism_checks.name: ControlledRestartWithFinalSampleAndCrashPoints
mechanism_checks.summary: node/internal/meter and node/internal/usagestore prove Barrier + FinalSample clean epoch handoff and crash injection across sample.read, sample.plan, before_commit, and after_commit with zero double counting or byte loss.

mechanism_checks.name: CounterResetAndExternalRulesetResetDetection
mechanism_checks.summary: enforce.DetectResets and enforce.DetectMeterResets detect both counter value decreases (2200 -> 100 B) and external chain/generation flushes, rotating meter_epoch_id while keeping event_seq monotonic.

mechanism_checks.name: FailClosedGateAndOutboxHysteresisRecovery
mechanism_checks.summary: agent.Decide blocks member forwarding with METER_PATH_INVALID, METER_STORAGE_FAILED, OUTBOX_FULL, and DISK_LOW while keeping control up; usagestore.EvaluateGate enforces sticky 80% hysteresis before resuming forwarding.

mechanism_checks.name: UPD03StatePreservedAcrossNodeUpdate
mechanism_checks.summary: Persistent SQLite state/usage.db preserves node_incarnation_id, acked_through, next_seq, and unACKed outbox events across node binary switches.
